summary: Fractal web reports the person's presence from the most recently active tab: present with recent input, idle when hidden or untouched for five minutes

schema.detail: No database, claim or client API change; the app uses the existing client-v0 availability operations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Reports go to POST /v1/client/presence on each change and every 10 minutes while present; only one tab per browser reports.

compatibility.detail: A pairing without write.presence, or a session without a person, reports nothing; a replay reports nothing.

recovery.detail: A stale report ages out after 15 minutes; set a status override to ignore presence.
